title: Edit/delete options on another user's customer note are hidden without the right permission
custom_preconds:
1. A customer has a note written by an admin, on its Notes tab.
  2. Two custom roles exist: role A with Customers View and Work orders View but no Work orders Delete.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the role-A user and open the customer's Notes tab.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Notes tab opens and the admin-written note is shown.

custom_steps_separated.content: Look at the admin-written note's action menu.
custom_steps_separated.expected: There is no action menu (no Edit/Delete/Attach) on another user's note.

custom_steps_separated.content: As the role-A user, create your own note on the same customer and check its actions.
custom_steps_separated.expected: On your own note, edit and delete your own note are available.

viu_status: Blocked-UI: needs a customer note authored by a DIFFERENT user, then observe edit/delete affordance hidden for a role lacking the note permission — requires seeding a note as user A and viewing as user B; not reachable with single Tech identity this pass.
evidence: Reworded; customer notes governed by Customers permission (not WO Delete). API/element jargon stripped.
